productBrief: focus-swarm: A synthetic focus-group platform where AI personas with persistent memory debate products. Researchers define a target market; system mints archetype iNFTs encrypted on 0G Storage, spawns them as AXL peer-to-peer nodes, runs moderated multi-turn session, synthesizes findings. Personas accumulate skills across sessions. Key tensions: synthetic vs real insight, cost per session ($0.50), slower 0G Compute vs GPT-4, personas can only speak not act, session quality depends on archetype diversity.
contradictions: The value of AI personas versus real user feedback
The importance of persona skills accumulation versus immediate usability
The relevance of synthetic insights versus practical application
painPoints: Lack of context between sessions for AI personas
Onboarding friction and confusion for users
Abstract nature of persona feedback without direct human input
opportunities: Identifying common pain points early through persona debates
Improving retention by guiding feature development based on persona insights
rawSummary: Panelists found the concept of AI personas debating products intriguing but questioned its ease and trustworthiness compared to real user feedback. They emphasized the need for concrete, actionable insights and highlighted concerns about context, onboarding, and privacy.
